outputSemantics.input: standardized raw OHLCV values in ohlcvColumns order
outputSemantics.head: standardized gap/body/upper-wick/lower-wick/log-volume-ratio values
outputSemantics.output: raw next OHLCV reconstructed using the previous close and anchored geometric-mean volume
outputSemantics.postprocess: relative clipping, non-negative wicks and daily volume limits are embedded in the graph; alpha=volumeAnchorStrength (zero for legacy checkpoints without anchors)
